supported_mvp.name: bar
limits: Requires a category and measure.

supported_mvp.name: horizontal_bar
supported_mvp.purpose: Compare ranked categories, especially when labels are long.
limits: Requires a category and measure.

supported_mvp.name: line
supported_mvp.purpose: Show trends over time or ordered sequences.
limits: Requires date or ordered x field and measure.

supported_mvp.name: area
supported_mvp.purpose: Show trend magnitude over time with filled area.
limits: Requires date or ordered x field and measure.

supported_mvp.name: stacked_area
supported_mvp.purpose: Show how multiple series contribute to a total trend over time.
limits: Requires x field, stack grouping, and measure.

supported_mvp.name: scatter
supported_mvp.purpose: Show relationship between two numeric fields.
limits: Requires numeric x and numeric y.

supported_mvp.name: bubble
supported_mvp.purpose: Show relationship between two numeric fields with a third value encoded as size.
limits: Requires numeric x, y, and size fields.

supported_mvp.name: pie
limits: Avoid more than 6 categories.
Avoid time series.
Avoid when precise ranking matters.

supported_mvp.name: donut
supported_mvp.purpose: Show simple part-to-whole composition with a central void for cleaner presentation.
limits: Avoid more than 6 categories.
Avoid time series.

supported_mvp.name: histogram
supported_mvp.purpose: Show the distribution of a single numeric field.
limits: Requires exactly one numeric field.
Bin count is automatic; manual binning not supported.

supported_mvp.name: box_plot
supported_mvp.purpose: Show spread and outliers of a numeric field, optionally grouped by a category.
limits: Requires at least one numeric field.
Optional grouping category.

supported_mvp.name: heatmap
supported_mvp.purpose: Show a matrix of values using colour intensity.
limits: Requires two categorical fields and one numeric measure.
Large matrices may be hard to read.

supported_mvp.name: stacked_bar
supported_mvp.purpose: Show part-to-whole composition across categories over groups.
limits: Requires a category, a stack-grouping field, and a measure.
Too many stack groups reduce readability.

supported_mvp.name: treemap
supported_mvp.purpose: Show hierarchical-looking composition as nested tiles.
limits: Current MVP uses a flat category-to-value treemap.

supported_mvp.name: waterfall
supported_mvp.purpose: Show stepwise increases and decreases across categories or stages.
limits: Requires ordered categories and a numeric measure.

supported_mvp.name: funnel
supported_mvp.purpose: Show stage drop-off or conversion through a pipeline.
limits: Requires ordered categories and a numeric measure.

supported_mvp.name: radar
supported_mvp.purpose: Compare values across multiple categories on a radial axis.
limits: Works best with a small number of categories.

supported_mvp.name: gauge
supported_mvp.purpose: Show a single key metric as an indicator gauge.
limits: Requires one numeric measure.
Current MVP uses an automatically derived gauge range.

supported_mvp.name: kpi_card
supported_mvp.purpose: Show a single key metric as a large numeric indicator.
limits: Requires one numeric measure.
